propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger globally, preventing subsequent caplog fixtures from capturing rebar.* logger records in the same process

tests using caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently (StopIteration, vacuous pass) when run after configure_logging() in the same worker process, with no failure indication pointing to the root cause
the failure is intermittent and order-dependent; the same test suite passes or fails depending on whether configure_logging() executes before caplog-asserting tests in a given test worker
configure_logging() is called at module import time from src/rebar/review_bot/app.py and directly from tests/unit/test_review_bot.py, both paths poisoning the process-global logger state
removing the propagate=False mutation from configure_logging() prevents the caplog poisoning while maintaining the original intent (no double-logging) via handler attachment and marker guards
